article.headline: Giving generated video a 3D representation you can use
article.lead: AEON decodes a video latent representation into renderable 4D Gaussian primitives. Joints, Camera, Action! generates video alongside motion for arbitrary rigs. Their extra outputs offer ways to inspect geometry and movement beyond watching a clip.

sections.heading: Unified framework for video and 3D models

paragraphs.text: AEON introduces a framework that combines video and 3D world models. It uses a generative model in a text- or image-conditioned video latent space to create renderable 4D graphics primitives via 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). This integration improves both realism and 3D consistency in simulations, achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks. The method includes a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents, enabling dynamic scene rendering and persistent environment construction.

Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs — The paper introduces a novel model that co-generates 3D motion and video for arbitrary rigs, improving upon existing methods that are limited to human skeletons or require extensive parameters.

OmniCam introduces a novel autoregressive model for generating camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual descriptions, achieving a 28-47% reduction in trajectory errors and a 65.8% decrease in collision rates compared to the GenDoP baseline.
MindView introduces a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence, featuring 1,500 samples across 513 scenes and seven tasks that assess geometry and semantics in spatial generation.

Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting — The paper introduces the Video-Point Model (VPM), a novel world model that enhances multi-view video forecasting by integrating camera-conditioned processing and point trajectory supervision.

Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models — The paper introduces $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, an enhanced Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture that integrates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models, addressing the limitations of existing JEPA frameworks.

Slot-JEPA introduces a novel architecture that enhances Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) by decomposing dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks, addressing challenges related to object structure recovery, temporal correspondence, and spatial displacement sensitivity.

PhysLDM introduces a novel latent-diffusion framework for high-fidelity deformable simulation, achieving approximately 2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes with up to 78x token compression.

WildMAE introduces a novel decoder-side extension to masked autoencoders (MAEs) for wildlife image reconstruction, achieving significant improvements in reconstruction quality with a PSNR of 27.90 dB compared to 24.33 dB for vanilla MAE at 75% masking.

Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation — The paper presents a novel approach to continual concept personalization in diffusion models through residual-space adaptation, achieving the highest concept fidelity among existing methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting.

Copyright Leakage Detection in AI Generated Videos — The paper introduces a benchmark dataset for copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos, consisting of 50 copyrighted concepts with corresponding generated videos.

VideoMaMa++ introduces a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework that enhances temporal consistency in video matting by employing separate token streams for RGB and mask conditioning, allowing for adaptive integration of texture and layout.

PVBench introduces a novel benchmark for quantitatively assessing the physical plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions, organized into seven domains, including geometric consistency and mechanical plausibility.

SpecKCast introduces a training-free method for accelerating diffusion models by forecasting outputs in the frequency domain using a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) and a lightweight Kalman filter.

Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes — The paper introduces the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that enables fine-grained guidance in dynamic video generation of painting processes.

Emily2040/seedance-2.0 — Seedance 2.0 is a comprehensive production pipeline designed for quad-modal AI filmmaking, integrating text, image, audio, and video modalities to streamline the creative process.

The paper introduces Self-Credit, a novel end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method that enhances credit assignment for long-horizon tasks by generating dense supervision signals from sparse rewards through self-generated credit assignment and intra-group rescaling.

vllm-project/vllm — The vllm project introduces a high-throughput and memory-efficient inference engine for large language models (LLMs), optimizing performance by leveraging techniques such as tensor parallelism and efficient memory management.
